audit: Subagent H — independent methodology red team
scope: Pinned RCAEval metadata; seven locally hash-verified raw cases; the full 90-case RE2-TT trace audit; and one targeted log-bearing RE2-TT multimodal case. No architecture, method, or Task-C choice is made.

checkpoint_corrections.claim: All metric/log/trace pairs can only be aligned by a time window.
checkpoint_corrections.resolution: CONTRADICTED IN PART. Logs and metrics have a deterministic direct key join at the exact container/entity plus epoch-second bin. Metrics-to-traces and logs-to-traces remain service plus time-window joins, with no request/span/event identity.

checkpoint_corrections.claim: High aggregate parent resolution is enough to treat the RE2-TT graph as complete.
checkpoint_corrections.resolution: CONTRADICTED. Overall resolution is 98.45274372%, but seven of 90 cases are below 90% and the lowest is 38.54287289%. Only resolved parent relations are observed graph evidence.

checkpoint_corrections.claim: The five RE2-TT root-cause labels define an acceptable candidate universe.
checkpoint_corrections.resolution: CONTRADICTED. Those five services come from labels. The telemetry-derived literal trace-service universe is 20–27 services per case; use only the latter before labels are read.

findings.challenge: Selection bias in the original six cases
findings.evidence: The plan deliberately stratifies modality, system, fault family, root-cause-file presence, and a timestamp anomaly; it is not a random or prevalence sample.
findings.resolution: Do not generalize six-case schemas or rates. The full-RE2-TT trace conclusion is separately supported by all 90 trace objects.

findings.evidence_scope: RAW SAMPLE FINDING and FULL-SUBSET PROPERTY
findings.evidence: Only the B2 trace audit covers all 90 RE2-TT trace files. Logs and metrics schemas/join behavior are raw evidence for selected cases only, including one normal log-bearing RE2-TT case.
findings.resolution: State the scope on every conclusion. Do not claim 89-case log schema or join prevalence from B2B.

findings.challenge: Operation representation mistaken for operation-level ground truth
findings.evidence_scope: FULL-SUBSET PROPERTY and DATASET-WIDE METADATA FACT
findings.evidence: All 90 RE2-TT trace files contain non-null serviceName and operationName, yielding 161 literal pairs; metadata and the pinned RE2-TT tree have no operation root-cause artifact.
findings.resolution: A literal (serviceName, operationName) representation is supported. Operation-level root-cause ranking is NOT EVALUABLE WITH CURRENT GROUND TRUTH.

findings.challenge: Root-cause service label mistaken for anomaly-node label
findings.evidence: RE2-TT has one root_cause_service label per case but no affected-node, per-node anomaly, or per-timestamp anomaly-object label.
findings.resolution: Do not report service-level anomaly evaluation or node-level anomaly F1. Service root-cause ranking remains separately evaluable.

findings.challenge: Injection target mistaken for an independently observable root cause
findings.evidence: There is no injection_target field or separate RE2-TT injection-target artifact. Case IDs encode the same root_cause_service label and cannot provide independent corroboration.
findings.resolution: Classify injection target as PARTIAL label provenance only; do not claim a telemetry-observed injection entity.

findings.challenge: Span-parent relations mistaken for calls or causal propagation
findings.evidence: All 90 RE2-TT trace schemas have only 11 flat fields and no span-kind, HTTP/RPC/peer, resource, messaging, attributes/events/links, or causal fields. There are 55 observed cross-service parent-child relation types.
findings.resolution: Use the label parent-to-child trace relation only. CALLS, USES, messaging, and causal propagation are NOT SUPPORTED BY DATASET.

findings.challenge: High-cardinality span names mistaken for a stable semantic operation identity
findings.evidence: Twelve operation strings are reused by more than one service, including GET and POST. The 161 pair keys are deterministic literal representations, not a typed operation vocabulary.
findings.resolution: Use the pair key only as a trace-derived representation; do not call it semantic operation ground truth.

findings.challenge: Approximate time alignment mistaken for direct multimodal correlation
findings.evidence: In targeted RE2-TT case cpu_2, 271,919/271,919 logs match a metric epoch-second and exact parsed container/entity; logs have no trace/span column and zero exact traceID/spanID matches; trace pairs use second bins and exact service strings.
findings.resolution: Logs↔metrics is DIRECT only at service/container-second aggregation. Logs↔traces and metrics↔traces are SERVICE+TIME, never direct event/request joins.

findings.evidence: In re3ss_carts_f1_1, one nonempty root_cause.txt cell exactly matches a log message. Metadata declares eight root-cause-file cases.
findings.resolution: root_cause.txt and its presence flag are FORBIDDEN MODEL INPUT.

findings.challenge: Fault-name and root-cause-name leakage through case IDs or paths
findings.evidence: A deterministic case-name parser recovers service, fault, and repetition correctly for 735/735 metadata rows and 90/90 RE2-TT rows.
findings.resolution: case ID and directory/path are FORBIDDEN MODEL INPUT; root_cause_service and fault are EVALUATION ONLY.

findings.evidence: RE2-TT inject_time exactly identifies each 720/721 normal/faulty boundary; two RE1 metadata cases lie outside their stated windows, and one was confirmed raw-invalid.
findings.resolution: inject_time is EVALUATION ONLY for RCA-GIVEN-KNOWN-INCIDENT-WINDOW and FORBIDDEN FOR END-TO-END DETECTION INPUT.

findings.challenge: Graph edges invented from architecture rather than telemetry
findings.evidence: Only trace IDs, span IDs, parent IDs, literal service strings, operation strings, and timing fields are present. No architecture source was required for the 55 observed relation types.
findings.resolution: Construct only literal nodes and resolved parent-child relations. Do not add topology, resource, or protocol edges from external architectural expectations.

findings.evidence: RE2-TT has traces and metrics in 90/90 cases but logs in 89/90; cpu_1 is the no-log case. Raw files confirm its trace+metric-only layout.
findings.resolution: No modality imputation is allowed. A trace+metric core can cover 90 cases; any log feature must use an explicit availability rule and must not silently fabricate cpu_1 logs.

findings.challenge: Resource identity overinferred from names such as mongo or repository text
findings.evidence_scope: FULL-SUBSET PROPERTY and RAW SAMPLE FINDING
findings.evidence: No typed host, pod/container, DB, logical database, cache, broker, queue/topic, peer, or resource attributes exist in the full RE2-TT trace schema. Metric/entity tokens and operation strings are untyped text.
findings.resolution: Resource nodes and USES edges are NOT SUPPORTED BY DATASET for this pilot; no resource-level ground truth is available.

findings.challenge: RE2-TT candidate universe restricted by injection-set knowledge
findings.evidence_scope: FULL-SUBSET PROPERTY and DATASET-WIDE METADATA FACT
findings.evidence: Five root-cause services are labels, while trace-visible candidate services range from 20 to 27 per case. Metadata has no candidate-universe field.
findings.resolution: Enumerate candidates only from telemetry visible before labels. Never restrict candidates to the five injected-service labels or a label-derived per-case set.

findings.challenge: Ranking metrics made trivial by small candidate cardinality
findings.evidence: Top-5 over the five known injected services is structurally trivial. Trace telemetry instead exposes 20–27 literal service candidates per case.
findings.resolution: A telemetry-derived 20–27 service universe avoids structural Top-5 triviality. Any label-restricted universe invalidates the metric.

findings.challenge: Aggregate parent-resolution rate hides case-level graph loss
findings.evidence: Overall parent resolution is 65,748,095/66,781,374 (98.45274372%), but seven cases fall below 90%; the minimum is re2tt_ts-route-service_disk_2 at 38.54287289%.
findings.resolution: Do not treat the trace graph as complete topology. Retain only resolved relations and report the per-case resolution rate in any later evaluation.

red_team_verdict: No raw evidence requires rejecting a RE2-TT trace-plus-metrics, service-level, known-window RCA pilot. The evidence requires a strict leakage-safe protocol, telemetry-derived candidates, and explicit limits: no resource graph, no causal/CALLS claims, no operation-level ranking, no service/node anomaly labels, and no direct event-level trace correlation.
